The '''Central Dwelling''' was a living area within the [[Gathering Circle]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan's]] lone city. The Dwelling was a low, circular building with a domed roof painted gold. It sat next to the coliseum used for governing of the populace, and was home to [[V-Tan]] and [[O-Vieve]], the city's [[Benevolent Guide]]s. The Central Dwelling was not part of the [[Dwelling Circle]], where many of the city's other residents resided.<ref name="TFFW">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref>
